methodologyNotes: Covers four- and three-wheeled rollator walkers (rolling walkers with a built-in seat and hand brakes) sold at a published US MSRP or typical retail price. Excludes standard pickup/folding walkers without wheels, knee scooters, transport wheelchairs, and rollator-transport-chair hybrids marketed primarily as wheelchairs. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD. wheelCount is the total number of wheels (3 or 4). frameMaterial is an enum: aluminum, steel, or carbon-fiber. wheelDiameterIn is the nominal front-caster diameter in inches. weightCapacityLbs is the manufacturer's rated maximum user weight in pounds. productWeightLbs is the rollator's own weight in pounds (as shipped, without accessories). seatHeightIn is the seat-surface height from the floor in inches (a range low-to-high if the seat or frame is height-adjustable). seatWidthIn is the seat width in inches. handleHeightMinIn and handleHeightMaxIn are the lowest and highest grip heights from the floor in inches. overallWidthIn is the widest external frame width in inches. foldedWidthIn is the width when folded for storage in inches. brakeType is an enum: loop-lock (squeeze-to-slow, push-down-to-park), push-down (press handle down to brake/park), or reverse-braking (brake engaged by default, squeeze to release). null where a spec is not disclosed by the manufacturer.
